subject: Vendor setup: PO checklist and request to adjust Net terms (Net45 -> Net30) + early-pay option

Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor: onboarding packet + request to shorten payment terms to Net 30 (currently Net 45)

Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking our call earlier today. Per our procurement kickoff, AcRelay is ready to complete Redwood's vendor onboarding but we have two asks before we can finalize PO issuance: 

1) Can Redwood accept Net 30 payment terms for our initial contract instead of the Net 45 your template shows? We typically run Net 30 and need that reflected on the PO.
2) We are also interested in an early-pay option (1.5% discount for payment within 10 days). If that's an option, can we opt into it for the first 3 invoices?

I attached our completed W-9 and can upload any vendor intake form you need. Also attaching the PO fields our SRM requires for automated routing.

Attachments: [Attachment: ACRelay_W9.pdf (PDF, 120KB)], [Attachment: AcRelay_PO_Fields.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

Would you prefer I route this to Redwood AP directly or coordinate with your procurement contact? We need to close onboarding by the end of next week to meet our internal quarter close.

Thanks,
Sofia Marte

Hi Sofia — appreciate the quick turnaround and the W-9. 

Short answers up front:
- We can typically support Net 30 for new vendors; this one will need a short review with Finance since our standard commercial team template is Net 45.
- Early-pay discounts are handled through a Finance pilot; I can request a one-off 1.5%/10-day pilot for the first 3 invoices, subject to AP sign-off.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Ill attach our vendor PO checklist and a completed Redwood PO template for your team to confirm fields (see attachment: Redwood_PO_Template_v2.xlsx).
2) Marissa (cc'd, Vendor Onboarding) will run vendor intake and kick the PO into our system.
3) Marissa + David (Finance AP, cc'd) will triage the Net-term request and the early-pay pilot — if Finance approves the pilot, we will document it on the PO and in the contract amendment.

Can you confirm the legal entity name and remit-to address that should appear on the PO? Also let me know if there are any required invoice metadata fields not in the attached PO template (e.g., cost-center, project code).

Ive flagged this as expedited since you mentioned quarter close next week. 

Best,
Logan Wright
